ex.en: Everything went smoothly.
ex.zh: 一切進行得很順利。

ex.en: I do hope everything will go smoothly.
ex.zh: 我真心希望一切順利。

ex.en: In order to move the project along smoothly, we have revised the plan several times.
ex.zh: 為了讓專案順利進行，我們已經修改計畫好幾次了。

ex.en: This car is running less smoothly than it used to.
ex.zh: 這輛車跑起來沒有以前那麼順了。

ex.en: She speaks English smoothly and confidently.
ex.zh: 她說英文流暢又有自信。

ex.en: The police arrested him for smuggling.
ex.zh: 警方以走私罪名逮捕了他。

ex.en: He smuggled snacks into the movie theater.
ex.zh: 他偷偷把零食帶進電影院。

ex.en: This room is too small to contain 50 men.
ex.zh: 這個房間太小，容納不了五十個人。

ex.en: The taxi I took was very old and small.
ex.zh: 我搭的那輛計程車又老又小。

ex.en: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
ex.zh: 水星是太陽系中最小的行星。

ex.en: Europe has a smaller population than Asia.
ex.zh: 歐洲的人口比亞洲少。

ex.en: There's a small problem with the order.
ex.zh: 這筆訂單有個小問題。

ex.en: This girl is always smiling, but she's not happy.
ex.zh: 這個女孩總是在微笑，但她並不快樂。

ex.en: I don't like the way he smiles.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡他笑的樣子。

ex.en: When I thought of that, I couldn’t help smiling.
ex.zh: 想到這件事，我忍不住笑了。

ex.en: She saw her mother and gave a little smile.
ex.zh: 她看見媽媽，露出了淺淺的微笑。

ex.en: She greeted every customer with a smile.
ex.zh: 她面帶微笑迎接每一位客人。

ex.en: You smoke far too much. You should cut back.
ex.zh: 你抽太多菸了，應該少抽一點。

ex.en: My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸一天抽一包菸。

ex.en: Tom never used to smoke, but he does now.
ex.zh: 湯姆以前從不抽菸，但現在會了。

ex.en: There was smoke coming from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房冒出了煙。

ex.en: The room was full of smoke.
ex.zh: 房間裡充滿了煙。

ex.en: This smells great! What are you cooking?
ex.zh: 聞起來好香！你在煮什麼？

ex.en: I hate it when my clothes smell of smoke.
ex.zh: 我討厭衣服有菸味。

ex.en: I don't like the way this fruit smells.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡這種水果的味道。

ex.en: Come and smell these flowers.
ex.zh: 過來聞聞這些花。

ex.en: Can you smell something burning?
ex.zh: 你有沒有聞到燒焦的味道？

ex.en: I've smelled this smell somewhere before.
ex.zh: 我以前在哪裡聞過這個味道。

ex.en: I love the smell of fresh coffee.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡剛煮好的咖啡香。

ex.en: He is not as smart as his older brother.
ex.zh: 他沒有他哥哥那麼聰明。

ex.en: I'm not as smart as I thought I was.
ex.zh: 我沒有自己以為的那麼聰明。

ex.en: You're a lot smarter than Tom and Mary are.
ex.zh: 你比湯姆和瑪麗聰明多了。

ex.en: I control the lights with my smart speaker.
ex.zh: 我用智慧音箱控制電燈。

ex.en: Smart devices make our homes more convenient.
ex.zh: 智慧裝置讓我們的家更方便。

ex.en: You look very smart in that suit.
ex.zh: 你穿那套西裝看起來很體面。

ex.en: Staff must wear smart clothes when meeting clients.
ex.zh: 員工和客戶見面時必須穿著得體。

ex.en: Her skin is smooth.
ex.zh: 她的皮膚很光滑。

ex.en: This scarf feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 這條圍巾摸起來又軟又滑。

ex.en: The reimagined user interface allows smoother play across devices.
ex.zh: 重新設計的使用者介面讓玩家在各種裝置上都能玩得更流暢。

ex.en: We hope for a smooth transition to the new system.
ex.zh: 我們希望能順利轉換到新系統。

ex.en: I'm looking for a smartphone with a good camera.
ex.zh: 我想找一支相機好用的智慧型手機。

ex.en: I still don't have a smartphone.
ex.zh: 我還是沒有智慧型手機。

ex.en: You can check in for your flight on your smartphone.
ex.zh: 你可以用智慧型手機辦理登機報到。

ex.en: I hate people who make small talk in quiet public places.
ex.zh: 我最討厭在安靜的公共場所閒聊的人。

ex.en: I'm not good at small talk with people I just met.
ex.zh: 我不擅長跟剛認識的人寒暄。

ex.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
ex.zh: 現在每個人都對天花免疫了。

ex.en: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.
ex.zh: 他們努力的目標是消滅天花。

ex.en: Smallpox was wiped out thanks to vaccines.
ex.zh: 多虧了疫苗，天花才被根除。
